lines: Anna University
REGULAR EXAMINATION — 2023
Engineering Mathematics-I — Regular Examination, 2023
Subject Code: MA101    Semester: 1    Regulation: R23
Time: 3 Hours    Max. Marks: 70
Note: This is a demo question paper generated for Backlog Buddy.
Answer all questions. Assume suitable data wherever necessary.
SECTION A  (Unit 1: Matrices and Linear Algebra)
1. Find the rank and eigenvalues of the given matrix. Verify the Cayley-Hamilton theorem for the given matrix.   [12 Marks]
2. Explain Matrices and Linear Algebra with a neat diagram/sketch and a suitable example.   [12 Marks]
3. Describe the working principle of Matrices and Linear Algebra with necessary equations.   [12 Marks]
SECTION B  (Unit 2: Differential Calculus)
4. State Rolle's theorem and Lagrange's mean value theorem. Verify them for the given function.   [12 Marks]
5. Define Differential Calculus. Explain its significance in Engineering Mathematics-I with a suitable example.   [12 Marks]
6. Explain Differential Calculus with a neat diagram/sketch and a suitable example.   [12 Marks]
SECTION C  (Unit 3: Integral Calculus)
7. Evaluate the given double integral by changing the order of integration.   [12 Marks]
8. Solve a problem related to Integral Calculus. Show all the steps clearly.   [12 Marks]
9. Write short notes on Integral Calculus.   [8 Marks]
SECTION D  (Unit 4: Vector Calculus)
10. Using Green's theorem, evaluate the given line integral around the closed curve. State Stokes' theorem and Gauss divergence theorem.   [12 Marks]
11. Compare and contrast the key concepts involved in Vector Calculus.   [12 Marks]
12. Write short notes on Vector Calculus.   [8 Marks]
SECTION E  (Unit 5: Ordinary Differential Equations)
13. Solve the given second order linear differential equation with constant coefficients.   [12 Marks]
14. Apply the fourth order Runge-Kutta method to solve the given initial value problem up to the required accuracy.   [8 Marks]
15. Explain Ordinary Differential Equations with a neat diagram/sketch and a suitable example.   [12 Marks]
*** End of Question Paper ***
